The HWPX inventory report generation succeeded by correctly parsing XML structures within the zipped HWPX format and mapping them to a structured inventory.
The execution achieved a 1.0 reward with all tests passing in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite. The solution successfully navigated the HWPX (Open Packaging Convention) structure to extract document metadata and content. Future iterations should ensure robust handling of varied XML namespaces and potential malformations in the underlying ZIP archive.
